title: Till guard rules
description: The common checks before payment, in one app. A check before payment: when the cashier presses Pay, the shop's server sends its priced basket and the service refuses a line priced at or below the shop's placeholder price (a free line is never refused) or a line holding more of one item than the shop allows, or a sale selling more lines than the retailer allows, and asks the cashier (or calls a manager) for a line priced below its item's lowest price, in the retailer's own price list of lowest prices (each item, each unit), or a sale at or above the shop's approval amount. A return is judged only for the items it sells (an exchange), by the line rules; the approval amount reads the total the customer pays. A capture on scan: an item whose 'Confirm at the till when scanned' is ticked beeps and asks a yes/no question before its line goes on the sale. If the shop ticks 'Warn of a shorter-dated batch instead of asking', a ticked item is answered with a notice instead, when the store holds a batch of it that expires sooner: the item goes on with no tap and the till shows which batch to sell first. The rules are the shop's own, in the record 'Default' of PP TGR Settings, each off until set; the service reads that record, and the lowest prices' Item Price rows when that list is set, with the app's integration user and writes nothing. The install makes the role PP TGR Integration; the shop gives it to the app's integration user. Both services install switched off; the shop reads what each is sent, ticks the consent and switches them on (to use approve, it first gives its managers May Approve a Partner's Check, then ticks 'May ask for a manager's approval' on the check). When the service is down the sale goes on and is flagged for review. allowed_urls is the programme bench's address; a partner writes its own.

fields.label: Title
fields.description: The service reads the record named Default.

fields.label: A line priced at or below this is refused (0 = off)
fields.description: For a placeholder price such as 0.01, in the sale's own currency (one number for every currency; a value smaller than the currency's smallest unit switches the rule off). A free line, priced 0, is never refused.

fields.label: Lowest prices
fields.description: A price list with each item's lowest price, one row per unit you sell it in, in the sale's currency. A line below it (after its own discount and any discount on the sale), or sold in a unit with no row, needs the cashier's answer or a manager, as chosen below. A free line is never judged. Blank = off. Give PP TGR Integration read on Item Price before you set this.

fields.label: Most of one item on a line (0 = no limit)
fields.description: Counted line by line: a promotion may split one item across two lines.

fields.label: Most lines on one sale (0 = no limit)
fields.description: A sale selling more lines than this is refused at Pay. Up to 499: the check is sent at most 500 lines.

fields.label: Sales of this amount or more need a manager (0 = off)
fields.description: In the sale's own currency; one number for every currency.

fields.label: How a sale needing a manager is checked
fields.description: For a large sale and a line below its lowest price. ask (the default): the cashier answers yes or no. approve: a manager who is not the cashier signs in on the till; it needs 'May ask for a manager's approval' ticked on the check service, else the answer is not used and the sale goes on, flagged.

fields.label: The question on a flagged item
fields.description: Asked when an item whose 'Confirm at the till when scanned' is ticked is scanned. Blank: 'Check this item before it goes on the sale. Add it?'

fields.label: Warn of a shorter-dated batch instead of asking
fields.description: From POS build 2.0.0.654. A ticked item scanned while the store holds a batch of it that expires sooner goes on with no tap, and the till shows which batch to sell first; otherwise nothing is shown. The question above is then not asked. Give PP TGR Integration read on Batch first.

custom_fields.label: Confirm at the till when scanned
